gen-dafont-redux-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands tall like capitals, its stroke ends all cut from one ribbon. Redux adds a wide-spaced, gently tapered heading above, so a long read feels steady and unhurried.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-hind-mysuru: Redux spaces its letters wide and swoops into every curve with a visible entrance. And Hind Mysuru follows with twine-like strokes and tall lowercase, so the heading flares and the text holds still.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara draws every stroke at a single line width, with spacious gaps in its rounded letters. Redux, though, is the one with a mild thick-thin shift and a showy curve entrance, while the sans does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-huninn: Redux stretches its letters wide and enters each curve with a visible lead-in, stems just heavier than the hairlines. Huninn offers the strongest single quality here: sans-serif strokes with no heavy-to-light shift, crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-karla: Karla reads stocky and friendly, its gaping c and tall middle band making each line look sturdy. And Redux's wide spacing and stone-carved heft give the pair its strongest quality: a confident, contemporary heading over a grounded sans.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-khula: Redux enters every curve with a big visible swoop, its letters spaced wide and its lowercase enlarged. Khula then supplies the pair's strongest quality: a tall, squat-bellied sans with open curves, nearly free of stroke variation.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-krub: Redux spreads wide letters across the line, each curve entered with a big visible lead-in. And Krub reads smoothly after it, a tall-bodied plain sans whose pen-lifted curves leave loops pleasantly unfinished.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-lexend: Redux lunges into every curve with a big, visible entrance. It earns its keep in large, short headings, while Lexend's sans-serif body keeps outsized lowercase and open jaws with no brush-style swell.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mada: Wide, swooping, a bit carved. Redux carries a stone-inscription heft up top, while Mada's towering sans-serif midzone and unclosed curves hold the text below.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-mozilla-text: Tall, sturdy lowercase with flared edges. Redux brings its dip-pen variation and wide spacing to the heading, while Mozilla Text keeps a long stretch of sans looking bold yet steady, its terminals flaring outward.
